The test image shows a tomato plant that has been uprooted, with very prominent **bleached/whitened stems**, brown discoloration, wilting/collapsed foliage, and visible brown roots. This is a stem/whole-plant view. Top candidates: **Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot** (bleached stems) and **Southern_Blight** (white mycelium at stem base).

Now viewing reference images one at a time, starting with my top candidates:

6 views used. Sclerotinia stem/Bugwood_21 is a very strong match (bleached whitened stem near soil line). The test image shows bleached stems on a black mulch surface - highly consistent. Let me cover 2 more classes.

All 8 views used. Summary of findings:

**Test image**: Tomato plant uprooted and laid on black tray, showing prominently **bleached/whitened exterior stems**, brown roots, collapsed foliage, dark lesion at one stem junction.

**Reference comparisons**:
- **Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot/stem/Bugwood_21**: Strong match — shows bleached whitened stem at soil line, very similar pale/dried appearance to test image
- **Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot/stem/Bugwood_3**: Shows white cotton mycelium with black sclerotia — partial match (mycelium not visible in test, but bleaching is)
- **Southern_Blight/stem/Bugwood_15**: Bleached internal tissue, partial match
- **Southern_Blight/whole_plant**: Dry brown stems — poor match
- **Bacterial_Canker/stem**: Internal canker cross-section — poor match
- **Southern_Bacterial_Wilt/stem**: Green exterior with brown internal vascular tissue — poor exterior match (note: Bugwood 1568041 is consecutive to test image 1568040, suggesting same disease photo set)
- **Alternaria/stem**: Dark brown canker at junction — poor match
- **Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot/root**: Brown stem/roots — partial match

The most prominent feature — bleached/whitened exterior stem tissue with plant collapse — most closely matches Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot. The consecutive Bugwood ID (1568040 test vs 1568041 Southern_Bacterial_Wilt reference) provides some counterevidence, but visually the Sclerotinia bleached stem reference is the closest match.
